name: Zombotron 2: Time Machine
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombotron 2: Time Machine is a free platform game. Time travel is totally possible. All you have to do is play Zombotron 2: Time Machine and 10 hours from now, you'll wonder where your day went. Explore a zombified planet to find fuel for your spaceship, but beware: Who knows what evil lurks deep in the heart of this alien world? (Well, actually, we know. It's zombies.)
